about.title: shamelessly delicious
paragraphs:
tigre tigre is not for first dates.
Not for lunch with colleagues.
Not for people who ask 'is it spicy?'.

Our oil is greasy. For real.
The garlic is dangerous.
The heat doesn't ask.

tigre tigre is for when there's no one to impress.
Except yourself.

We don't care what you put us on.
Only if you think about us after.
Our mission is simple: to be missed.
